title: Amazon Basics Double-Tipped Cotton Swabs for Personal Hygiene and Baby Care, Cotton, Versatile, Baby Safe, 500 Count

reviews.title: Quality and savings at the same time
reviews.body: As always, Amazon Basics continues to offer excellent alternatives to more expensive name-brand products, and these double-tipped cotton swabs are no exception.The quality is exactly what I was hoping for. The cotton tips are soft, securely attached, and hold up well during use without easily unraveling or bending. They work perfectly for everyday personal care needs, as well as the many other uses cotton swabs seem to have around the house.Honestly, I wouldn't be surprised if many of these store-brand products are manufactured by the same companies that produce the name brands. Whatever the case, these perform just as well as the more expensive options I've used in the past.If you're looking to save money without sacrificing quality, these Amazon Basics cotton swabs are an excellent choice. It's nice to find a product that delivers both value and reliability.I would definitely purchase these again and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a smart, budget-friendly alternative to the big-name brands.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 6, 2026

reviews.title: Good quality swabs
reviews.body: High quality, good thickness, standard size. I use these to remove eyeliner, and they work great. I also put a few in my first aid kit since I keep burn ointment there. That way it's better to use the ointment with reduced chance of spreading oil or germs from fingers, and to keep fingers clean of ointment.

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.body: We reorder this item frequently. The cotton content is excellent and is thick. It doesn’t pull off easily. The quantity in the box is plenty to get our family of four through a month. If you have skin sensitivity, these are for you. We have sensitive skin in our family and have no concerns with this product. This product cleans well and the shape of the actual cotton tip holds well.
